# Kevin Eaton - Martial Arts

> Kevin Eaton is a 4th Degree Black Belt Master Instructor (Sabumnim) in Taekwondo, Kukkiwon certified, founder of Jung Shin Academy. Also trains/teaches Tangsoodo, Shotokan Karate, and weapons (staff and sword).

This site covers his martial arts background: focus areas/disciplines, training and certifications, competition results and awards, and belt rank promotions.

## More about Kevin Eaton

- [Hub / all sites](https://kevineaton.net): Links to all of Kevin's professional sites.
- [Technology](https://tech.kevineaton.net): Software architecture, engineering leadership, and entrepreneurship.
- [Military](https://military.kevineaton.net): US Army Reserve service as a Chaplain (Lieutenant Colonel).
- [Academia](https://academia.kevineaton.net): University teaching experience and academic publications.
